tests.notes: Exact integrated HEAD c4f533d6a86f735c4d28612800f4be52be60fcaa was copied to a clean /tmp tree. Isolated Node 24.19.0/npm 11.12.1 npm ci added 291 packages, audited 292 with zero vulnerabilities, and left package-lock.json byte-identical. The final externally provisioned Node 24 frontend verify passed contract freshness, lint, strict typecheck, 27/27 unit/component tests, build, and 12/12 Playwright tests across desktop/mobile. Those browser tests passed the real FastAPI-to-Vite proxy smoke while the parent environment deliberately contained credential sentinels; Playwright started a non-reused backend with provider variables overridden, and the UI rendered deterministic-only fallback. Reduced-motion emulation, page overflow assertions, evidence focus return, pipeline retry, and axe scans passed. The independent suite passed 14/15: all Gemini and pipeline states, exact bodyless relative POST, malformed nested data, malformed model metadata, fixed local proxy configuration, absence of Vite parent allow configuration, and absence of committed LD_LIBRARY_PATH/home mutation passed; only Node type-major alignment failed because package.json declares @types/node ^22.13.5 and npm resolves 22.20.1 while runtime/engine are Node 24. The first full browser invocation without host library provisioning failed all 12 browser cases at launch because this workstation lacks system libnspr4.so; no test was skipped. Supplying the workstation library location externally, rather than restoring a committed loader mutation, produced the final passing browser and verify runs; CI separately installs Chromium system dependencies with playwright install --with-deps. A live Vite request for the parent contracts/openapi.yaml through /@fs returned 403 Restricted and listed only frontend as allowed. Backend regression passed 51/51, agentic regression passed 12/12, OpenAPI validation passed, npm audit reported zero vulnerabilities, and strict hash-locked Python audit found no known vulnerabilities. Task/report validation, git diff --check, and tester scope check passed for exactly 2 tester-owned changed files. No tests were skipped, xfailed, flaky, or retried.

blockers.description: The approved Node 24 frontend toolchain declares engine ^24.0.0 but directly depends on @types/node ^22.13.5, resolving Node 22.20.1 definitions. This leaves compile-time Node APIs on a different major line and fails the independent Node 24 tooling-alignment test.
blockers.suggestion: Align @types/node to the Node 24 major, synchronize package-lock.json with npm, and rerun the clean Node 24 install, independent suite, frontend verify, audits, and regressions.

notes_for_next_agent: yaml ^2.7.0 is an unused direct devDependency: repository search finds no YAML import/config use and npm explain shows it only as the root declaration plus Vite's optional peer. Because clean install, build, tests, lock reproducibility, and audit pass, this is recorded as non-blocking dependency/supply-chain hygiene; remove it and resynchronize the lock when correcting Node typings.

frontend/scripts/generate-api.js line 20 contains two trailing spaces. This is non-blocking hygiene because generation freshness and build pass, but it should be removed in the same frontend-owned cleanup.

All three prior report blockers are otherwise resolved: malformed nested/model metadata reject, committed credential-free proxy and reduced-motion/responsive coverage pass, Node engine/docs use 24, Vite parent access returns 403, and no committed LD_LIBRARY_PATH mutation remains.
